description: People with no recorded mail in either direction for a while, quietest first, with the latest contact date. Use for relationships that have gone quiet, not as a ranking of who is worth contacting. Coverage is limited to connected mailboxes and imported metadata. `days` sets the threshold; the default is six months.

days.description: Quiet for at least this many days. Default 182.

name: quiet_contacts
title: Who has gone quiet
